turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling. I'm the virtual assistant for your internet and phone service. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: hi yeah i want to switch my plan to the faster fiber one the five hundred not the basic one

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can help you look at a faster plan. First, can you confirm the phone number on the account? You can say it digit by digit.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: its five five five oh one nine eight two

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, I have the account. You're currently on the basic 100 megabit plan, and the 500 megabit fiber plan is available at your address. Would you like the upgrade to start on your next billing date?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: yeah next billing is fine also i dont need the router rental i have my own

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Understood. I can note the upgrade, but removing the router rental and changing the equipment charges needs our plan changes team to finish. I'm going to move you into their queue now so they can complete the switch with you. You'll stay on the line and someone will be with you shortly.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: ok wait is it gonna cost more per month

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The plan changes team will go over the exact monthly price for the new plan and confirm the equipment change before anything is finalized. Thanks for your patience, I'm transferring you to them now.
